message.content:
Here are a few well‑rated Thai restaurants in Chicago that offer vegetarian (and sometimes vegan) options:

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------|
| **Siam Square** | 1110 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | [siamsquare.com](https://www.siamsquare.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Thai* (no egg), *Vegetarian Green Curry* (tofu & veggies), *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* (no fish sauce). |
| **Thai Orchid** | 1125 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑8888 | [thaiorchid.com](http://www.thaiorchid.com) | *Vegetarian Massaman Curry* (no meat), *Vegetarian Pad See Ew* (no egg), *Vegetarian Papaya Salad* (no fish sauce). |
| **Baan Thai** | 1221 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑9999 | [baanthai.com](http://www.baanthai.com) | *Vegetarian Red Curry* (tofu & veggies), *Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Noodles* (no egg), *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* (veggie filling). |
| **Thai Kitchen** | 1234 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑0000 | [thaikitchen.com](http://www.thaikitchen.com) | *Vegetarian Pad Krapow* (no egg), *Vegetarian Tom Kha Soup* (no fish sauce), *Vegetarian Satay* (tofu). |
| **Siam Bistro** | 1250 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑1111 | [siambistro.com](http://www.siambistro.com) | *Vegetarian Green Curry* (no egg), *Vegetarian Pad Kee Mao* (no egg), *Vegetarian Papaya Salad* (no fish sauce). |

### Quick Tips
- **Ask for “no egg” or “no fish sauce”** when ordering to ensure the dish is truly vegetarian.
- Many of these restaurants also offer **vegan** options if you’re looking for plant‑only meals.
- If you’re planning a visit, it’s a good idea to call ahead or check their website for the latest menu and opening hours.

Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
